# Conqueror Roadster 450 Common Problems

## Engine Issues
- **Starting problems** - Difficulty cold-starting; check battery and spark plugs
- **Overheating** - Coolant leaks or thermostat failures
- **Oil leaks** - Gasket deterioration common as bike ages
- **Carburetor issues** - Clogging and fuel delivery problems (if carbureted model)

## Electrical Problems
- **Battery drain** - Faulty charging system or parasitic drain
- **Alternator failure** - Insufficient charging capacity
- **Wiring harness corrosion** - Especially in humid climates

## Transmission/Drivetrain
- **Clutch slippage** - Worn friction plates
- **Gear grinding** - Synchronizer wear
- **Chain issues** - Premature wear or breakage

## Suspension & Handling
- **Weak suspension** - Poor damping for heavier riders
- **Brake fade** - Inadequate stopping power under load
- **Vibration at highway speeds** - Wheel balance or engine issues

## Build Quality
- **Loose fasteners** - Regular checks needed
- **Paint durability** - Premature peeling or fading
- **Rust concerns** - Chrome plating quality varies

## Tips
✓ Regular maintenance is critical for reliability
✓ Source genuine or quality aftermarket parts
✓ Check owner forums for your specific year/model
✓ Inspect pre-purchase if buying used
